logline: A prequel following teenage Elle Woods through 1990s Seattle high school, years before Harvard Law turns her into the woman the movies made famous.

bollymeter.basis: 54% on Rotten Tomatoes across 41 critics and 52 on Metacritic from 18 critics, both squarely mixed; reviewers credited Lexi Minetree's performance while calling the premise a rehash of prequel nostalgia.

pull_quotes.text: Brings sparkle and excellent mimicry to rehashed proceedings, a mildly entertaining case study in prequel nostalgia.

seasons.review_body: Elle sends Reese Witherspoon's franchise back to 1990s Seattle, recasting Elle Woods as a high schooler six years before Harvard Law, with newcomer Lexi Minetree carrying the title role. Critics split closer to skeptical than won over: Rotten Tomatoes logged the show at 54% across 41 reviews, Metacritic settled at 52 from 18 critics, both landing in mixed territory. The RT consensus credited Minetree with real sparkle and mimicry even while calling the show a rehash leaning on prequel nostalgia rather than a fresh angle. What lands: a game lead finding her own version of an iconic character. What does not: a premise that spends its first season proving it needed to exist. Amazon renewed it for season 2 anyway, betting the format finds its footing.
